title: BTCC launches BTCC Earn
description: BTCC announced the launch of BTCC Earn with a Flexible Earn product advertised at up to 20% APY and a limited new-user two-day Fixed Earn promotion advertised at 300% APY.
notes: This is the verified first-party BTCC Earn launch date. The headline APY figures are issuer-advertised product terms and are not treated as independently verified realized returns.
